name: magic-ui-terminal
title: Terminal
description: A small shell panel with three window dots that plays log lines in order: commands type themselves character by character and result lines fade in one after another.
use: A docs or landing page should show a command-line flow playing itself out without a real shell.
avoid: Pages where the text must be copied or read at once; lines start empty and fill slowly.
a11y: There is no live region or heading, so assistive tech meets partial lines as they type and no pause. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded panel on black, its thin header strip carrying small red, yellow and green dots at the left. Below, monospaced lines appear in green for confirmations and grey for commands and notes, each confirmation led by a green tick.
behaves: The first command types itself out a character at a time, then each result line drops into place in sequence with a short fade and pause. A second command then types and its final line appears, after which the panel stops.
customise: Compose output lines as children using the typing and fading variants; typing speed, delay, order and start-on-view are props on each part.
weight: light: A dozen lines with brief fades and one interval-driven typing loop.
